sources.entry: MakeItHome - Pointer-driven launcher for screen-edge quick actions and app switching. ![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/it/app/makeithome-screen-extender/id6444596296?l=en-GB&platform=mac)

summary.one_liner: MakeItHome is a macOS app that extends the desktop past the screen edges into an "overscreen" with live window previews for app switching, app pinning, and a top-edge Widgets Zone.
summary.what_it_does: Pushing the cursor past a screen border opens the overscreen, where running apps appear as cards with live, real-time window previews; clicking a card jumps to that window. Apps can be pinned (locked) to a screen edge so they stay one flick away across Spaces. The top edge hosts a Widgets Zone with built-in Notes and Tasks, a month-view Calendar with daily agenda, a Clipboard history (text, rich text, images, files), and user-added custom web widgets. A web search bar shows results in an overlay. A App Extension API lets third-party apps render their own interactive area in the overscreen, with a demo app and a MakeItHome Web extension for Safari. The README says window captures are processed on the Mac and not saved to disk or sent online. Current release is 2.1.0 on the Mac App Store, and the README also describes development branches for 2.1.1 and 2.1.2.
use_cases: switch between running apps with window previews
pin favorite apps to a screen edge
extend a Mac desktop beyond the screen edge
keep notes, tasks and calendar within reach
add custom web widgets to a screen edge
preview and switch Safari tabs from the overscreen
how_to_run: Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions
notable: Overscreen extends beyond physical screen edges with live window previews
App Extension API gives third-party apps an interactive WebView area in the overscreen
Configurable Widgets Zone with Notes, Tasks, Calendar, Clipboard and custom web widgets
MakeItHome Web browser extension lets Safari tabs be previewed and selected from the overscreen
caveats: Requires macOS 12.3 or later and needs Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions
Several features are listed as in progress: external app widgets, App Extension tutorial and API docs, and browser extensions for other browsers
Multi-display, Safari and permission behavior are noted in the README as still needing manual validation
